topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I can't believe it's really happening. My best friend is moving, and not just down the street—across the country. It’s like a piece of me is packing up too. We’ve shared everything, the highs and the lows, always there for each other without question. Now, every call, every text feels like the last. But then, there’s this resolve that wells up inside. I’m committed to making this work. No matter the miles, no matter the time zones, we will find our way. Because some bonds are unbreakable, and ours is one of them. It’s a promise to myself, and to them, that distance won’t change what we have.
